title: Repeat-Downgrade Retention Charge — Northgate Memberships
content:
**Schedule entry.** A repeat-downgrade retention charge is kept back from the downgrade difference refund of a Northgate Memberships Plus membership when a downgrade difference refund was already paid on the membership: 10.00 dollars when one was paid in the 36 months before the downgrade, 5.00 dollars when the latest was paid 36 to 71 whole months before, and nothing otherwise. A membership with no current-year Plus premium gets no downgrade difference refund at all.

**Counting.** Earlier downgrade difference refunds are the downgrade difference refund entries on the membership's ledger. "In the 36 months before the downgrade" means fewer than 36 whole months separate the refund date from the downgrade date; "36 to 71 whole months before" means at least 36 and fewer than 72 whole months.

| Earlier downgrade difference refunds on the membership | Retention charge kept back |
|---|---|
| at least one fewer than 36 whole months before the downgrade | 10.00 |
| none within 36 whole months; the latest 36 to 71 whole months before | 5.00 |
| none, or only ones 72 or more whole months before | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- One earlier downgrade difference refund, 14 whole months before: 10.00.
- Two earlier refunds, 40 and 65 whole months before: none within 36 months; latest at 40 months — 5.00.
- One earlier refund, 80 whole months before: nothing.
- One earlier refund, exactly 36 whole months before: outside the 36 months, inside 36 to 71 — 5.00.
